Some bottled water can legally come from a public water supply 💧
In England, bottled water is sold as one of three types. Natural mineral water must come from a protected underground source, be recognised by the local authority (which can take up to 2 years) and can't be disinfected. Spring water is bottled at an underground source. Bottled drinking water can come from any source, including public supplies. Tap water, meanwhile, met the standards in 99.97% of tests in England in 2025.

Tap or bottled: which do you drink? Comment your town 👇
Source: Defra (GOV.UK), Drinking Water Inspectorate
